message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-07 13:10 IST to 2026-11-08 13:10 IST (2026-11-07 07:40 to 2026-11-08 07:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

No newly reported or newly updated vulnerability was verified in the last 24 hours as relevant to a component and version in the assigned DLL inventory. Recent CVE and advisory feeds were checked against normalized component names and aliases; unrelated products, loose vendor-name matches, stale disclosures, and duplicate reports were excluded.

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm and App Services, and official integrations. No new MongoDB advisory or CVE was verified inside the scan window. The most recent relevant entries on the [official MongoDB alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) predate this window; cross-checks of [NVD MongoDB records](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/search/results?query=mongodb&search_type=all) and the [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) did not identify an in-window MongoDB finding.

**Closing:** No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this 24-hour scan. Continue routine monitoring; this result does not change the status of vulnerabilities disclosed before the window.
